title: SentinelRuntimeEventV2
description: Sentinel Runtime Event Contract v2 draft R1.4: complete native Tetragon materialization with privacy-preserving defaults, source-aware payloads, and explicit partial process identity.

process_uid_raw.description: Raw Process.uid retained for unresolved provider identity collisions

credentials_euid_raw.description: Raw ProcessCredentials.euid retained for unresolved provider identity collisions

raw_payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact provider response bytes; null only when a metrics scrape failed before receiving a response body

device_id.description: Linux dev_t encoded as canonical decimal string

uint32String.description: Canonical decimal string representation of a 32-bit unsigned integer (0 to 4294967295)

uint64.description: 64-bit unsigned integer represented safely as a canonical decimal string without leading zeros (0 to 18446744073709551615) or as an integer (0 to 2^53 - 1)

linuxPath.description: Linux filesystem path up to 4096 chars, strictly rejecting NUL byte (U+0000) while preserving other valid characters (newlines, tabs, spaces)

lossMetric.description: Structured loss metric with honest observed state and unconstrained 64-bit capacity
